_roles: Each pack colour is swapped for its role colour. primary = logo letters, type, carton lid and base flap, dentist badge (was Deep Navy). accent = the V and the small claims text (was Slate Grey). light = the wave and the V on dark (was Ice Blue). band = the wave's second band (was Soft Silver). White and black (barcode, symbols) never change.

original.name: Original
original.note: The current palette. Deep navy does most of the work, with ice blue and silver.

bright.name: Bright
bright.note: A clear clinical blue with an aqua accent. Fresh, lighter on the eye, and mostly white.

aqua.name: Aqua
aqua.note: Navy gives way to a sea-glass teal with an aqua mist. Fresh, calm, and less corporate.

_ranges: ranges: [dark, light] per range. Dark = lid, base flap, badge and the V on white; light = the wave and the V on the dark. Logo letters and type stay the palette's primary. Bright keeps each range's hue at the option's brightness. Aqua takes Restore's teal for the core, so Restore moves to a mineral blue and Daily Care to a fresher leaf green (worked out in CIE LCh).
